name: pmis
description: PMIS — works, procurement and payments for a Public Works Department

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix app/server && npm install --prefix app/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix app/server && npm run typecheck --prefix app/client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix app/server && npm run build --prefix app/client
scripts.build:api: npm run build --prefix app/server && node scripts/build-demo-db.mjs
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
